title: RUN OVER HOLDS A MOMENT
why: His number 39, full controller navigation. On the demo attract any key, click or button drops a new run in, and that included the presses still coming from the fight that just ended: a player mashing fire or roll as he died went straight into a fresh run and never saw RUN OVER or his score. For the first second and a half after a run ends those presses are now ignored (the initials card still takes its letters); after that any press drops in as before.
now: The RUN OVER card ignores presses for a moment so mashing does not skip it.
